newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Totta shares drop more than five pct.
newsitem.headline: Totta shares drop more than five pct.

text.p: Shares of Portuguese bank Banco Totta e Acores fell more than five percent after a report that the Portuguese bank's president Alipio Dias had resigned, dealers said.
Some said it was feared that his eventual resignation could signal a break with the bank's past policy of paying out high dividends.
"The sellers are afraid that the departure of Alipio Dias is synonymous with a change in the policy of good dividends," said one dealer.

According to a report in weekly Semanario Economico, Luis Champalimaud, son of the head and founder of the Champalimaud group Antonio, could combine the chairmanship of both of the group's major banks, Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor and Banco Totta.
Totta shares hit a low of 3,000 escudos before closing at 3,030 escudos, down 171, in volume of 500,325 shares.
